_comment: There was no tsconfig here until now: node runs the .ts files directly by stripping types, so nothing ever CHECKED them. That is the gap this file closes — `npm run typecheck` is the correctness gate, exactly as in software-factory (D15), and it is separate from Biome, which never looks at types.
_importsComment: Every import in this repository carries the .ts extension, because that is what node's stripper resolves at runtime. TypeScript only accepts that with allowImportingTsExtensions, which in turn requires noEmit — which is what we want anyway: this config checks, it does not build. (Unknown keys are illegal INSIDE compilerOptions, so the notes live out here.)
_strictComment: Effect leans on inference hard; without strict the checker silently agrees with wrong code and the gate becomes decoration.
_includeComment: store/ holds the installable packages — copies of cubes that land in a running system. They are checked too: a package that does not typecheck is one that breaks after install, which is the worst moment to find out.
_exactOptionalComment: READ THIS BEFORE FIXING A TS2379 OR TS2375. `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` (below) changes what `?:` means, and the whole repository got it wrong the same way on one day: `readonly x?: string` does NOT mean `may be undefined`. It means ABSENT or a string — a property that is PRESENT and holds undefined is rejected. The thing that produces exactly that, everywhere, is a spread: `{ ...current, ...payload }` copies `payload.x` as an own property whose value is undefined when the caller did not send it. So the object you built to be permissive is the one the checker refuses. The fix is `readonly x?: string | undefined`, which says both. It is a WIDENING, not a cast: nothing is silenced, the optional simply admits the value it was always going to receive. Do not reach for `as`, do not drop the flag — either one trades a compile error for a runtime surprise, and the flag is the reason the surprise is visible at all. Written after seven of these were repaired in one day, in kernel, host and store alike; `grep -rn '?: .* | undefined' src store plugins` finds the ones already stated, each with the reasoning next to it.
